scope: unblended calibrated direct-head probabilities vs the same-family CUDA control, before June blend / G0 mix; not G15 mix, not policy; descriptive repeated-DEV; no decision, ranking or winner

seed_block.note: Stage A, descriptive: unblended head contrasts before the G0 mix and the June blend. The seeds are the adoption seeds 0-4 of G15/G0 (0-2 already MODEL RNG seeds of other arms in P24/P25/P27/P29, 3-4 of EXP-P30-001 arms) on the same export and exposed DEV rows: not new data, not an independent confirmatory test; family designed after reading P34/P35 (post-selection); epoch cap 60 for every arm; *_vs_control rows change several factors; one TabM-mini fit (k=8) vs one single-network fit is not compute-matched; same_gpu_pairs is observed, not scheduled; per-fit cap hits in provenance.tasks.*.epoch_cap
